label: Command Editor
tagline: Manage custom commands from chat, and choose who can.
description: Anyone can type !cmd for a link to your public command list. Your team can also manage custom commands from chat: !cmd add, !cmd edit and !cmd remove change the list, !cmd disable turns a command off and keeps its reply (handy for a speedrun or a focused stream), !cmd enable turns it back on, and !cmd perm sets who can use a command. Pick below who may run each one. All of them start at moderators. Switch the module off to stop !cmd entirely.

commands.cmd: Link to your public command list.
commands.cmd_edit_name_response: Change a command reply; its other settings stay.
commands.cmd_disable_name: Turn a command off without deleting it.
commands.cmd_enable_name: Turn a disabled command back on.
commands.cmd_perm_name_level: Set who can use a command: everyone, sub, vip, mod, lead_mod or broadcaster.
